scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.docker:smoke: sh -c 'docker compose --env-file ${WEB_ENV_FILE:-client/.env} up -d ${SMOKE_BUILD:---build} --wait --wait-timeout 180 && curl -fsS -o /dev/null http://localhost:8080/ && curl -fsS http://localhost:8080/api/health; status=$?; docker compose --env-file ${WEB_ENV_FILE:-client/.env} down; exit $status'
